text:
kate_partnerships: quick recap from today's sync with HW partners — there's a recurring regression when marketplace images combine driver X.Y.Z with our runtime build. proposing a 'binary compatibility bridge' that normalizes user-space drivers and injects a small shim to avoid ABI breaks. thoughts?

mike_eng_runtime: shim how? user space wrapper that aliases changed symbols?

kate_partnerships: yeah, small LD_PRELOAD-ish shim for the marketplace container, plus a strict matrix we validate in CI before publishing images. keeps kernel modules untouched.

andre_devex: that feels safer than forking vendor drivers. can we automate verification?

jen_oncall: need a rollback plan if shim causes perf regressions; oncall will want a toggle per-region.

sam_marketplace: marketplace teams can accept images with an extra metadata flag. we can gate rollout to 10% of installs, then 50%. we'll need clear signing so partners accept it. :white_check_mark: 

nvidia_partner: from Nvidia side, we prefer pinned driver versions, but ok with a compatibility layer if it doesn't touch kernel space. need the exact syscall/symbol list.

amd_partner: ROCm teams asked for test vectors — memory alloc/free, kernel launch latencies, and kernel ABI hashes. can you provide?

kate_partnerships: yes — we'll publish a small test harness and perf suite. initial plan: create repo redwood/compat-bridge, branch partners/marketplace-bridge. artifacts in s3://redwood-artifacts/compat-bridge/{build_ts}/ ; tests return pass/fail + perf delta.

mike_eng_runtime: backlog items for eng-runtime: 1) small shim binary + source 2) CI job that pulls vendor driver packages and runs compat tests 3) rollout toggle in control-plane. estimate 2 sprint points each?

andre_devex: I'll draft quickstart for partners explaining how to opt into the image and how to revert. short doc + sample Dockerfile.

kate_partnerships: sample Dockerfile snippet for marketplace image: 
```
FROM redwood/runtime:stable-2026-03
ADD compat-bridge/compat.so /opt/compat/compat.so
ENV LD_PRELOAD=/opt/compat/compat.so
LABEL com.redwood.compat-bridge=enabled
```

jen_oncall: please add a kill-switch endpoint for toggling LD_PRELOAD via config; we can't redeploy to flip in the middle of incidents.

sam_marketplace: marketplace acceptance tests will include signature verification. add a label with artifact SHA256 and a signed manifest from partner side.

nvidia_partner: we'll run our internal ABI checker across the provided tests. if anything fails we'll provide symbol diffs.

amd_partner: same from ROCm team. also please include CPU fallback path for customers using headless VMs.

mike_eng_runtime: for CI: we should run quick canaries in eu-west and us-west endpoints only, then expand. tie to rollout policies in the console.

kate_partnerships: communications note — do not announce publicly until partners sign-off. internal partners@tmpl and marketplace PMs will get an embargoed deck. timeline suggestion: week 0 (prototype + tests), week 1 (partner runs), week 2 (canary rollout), week 3 (gradual expand).

andre_devex: I'll open PR with README + test harness. PR link will be posted here when ready.

deploy-bot: build redwood/compat-bridge:pr-1 succeeded (artifact: s3://redwood-artifacts/compat-bridge/1837600205/bridge.tar.gz) :rocket:

kate_partnerships: awesome — next: mike, can you assign owners for CI jobs and a perf SLA threshold? jen, please prepare rollback runbook template. sam, start the marketplace gating doc. partners, we'll send the test vectors by EOD.

jen_oncall: noted. I'll prepare runbook skeleton and include escalation matrix.

mike_eng_runtime: assigned: CI job owner @mike_eng_runtime, perf SLA target preliminary +5% latency max vs baseline, we'll refine after partner runs.

nvidia_partner: expecting vectors by EOD. thanks.

amd_partner: same — ROCm team standing by.

kate_partnerships: thanks all — I'll follow up with the embargoed deck and PR link. leaving thread open for partner updates. :handshake:
